title: Peripheral TDP-43 pathology in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: toward a systemic proteinopathy
title_zh: 外周TDP-43病理在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中的表现：迈向系统性蛋白病
abstract: Abstract Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons. Cytoplasmic accumulation of phosphorylated TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (pTDP-43) is the pathological hallmark of most ALS cases. While ALS has traditionally been viewed as a disease confined to the brain, spinal cord and motor nerves, recent studies have reported pTDP-43 pathology in multiple other tissues (skeletal and cardiac muscle, skin, minor salivary glands, gastrointestinal tract and lymph nodes), referred to as peripheral pathology. The detection of pTDP-43 beyond the nervous system suggests that ALS-associated TDP-43 proteinopathy may be more widespread than previously recognized and raises fundamental questions regarding the spatial and temporal landscape of ALS pathology. Peripheral pTDP-43 accumulation may reflect a systemic biological susceptibility affecting multiple tissues, propagation of pathological TDP-43 species between anatomical compartments, or a combination of both mechanisms. While its biological significance is yet to be determined, the presence of pTDP-43 in peripheral tissues broadens the current conceptual framework of ALS. It may also provide new opportunities for pathology-based biomarkers, therapeutic monitoring, and mechanistic studies aimed at understanding disease initiation and progression. However, current evidence is derived from small and methodologically heterogeneous cohorts, and peripheral pTDP-43 pathology is not restricted to ALS, emphasizing the need for larger standardized studies.
abstract_zh: 摘要：肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，特征为上、下运动神经元的进行性退化。磷酸化的TAR DNA结合蛋白43（pTDP-43）在细胞质中的积累是大多数ALS病例的病理标志。虽然ALS传统上被视为局限于大脑、脊髓和运动神经的疾病，但近期研究报告了pTDP-43病理在多种其他组织（骨骼肌、心肌、皮肤、少量唾液腺、胃肠道和淋巴结）中的存在，称为外周病理。pTDP-43在神经系统之外的检测表明，ALS相关的TDP-43蛋白病可能比先前认为的更为广泛，并提出了关于ALS病理空间和时间分布的根本性问题。外周pTDP-43的积累可能反映了影响多种组织的系统性生物学易感性、病理TDP-43物种在解剖区间的传播，或两种机制的组合。其生物学意义尚未确定，但pTDP-43在外周组织中的存在扩展了当前对ALS的概念框架。它也可能为基于病理的生物标志物、治疗监测和旨在理解疾病发起与进展的机制研究提供新的机会。然而，目前的证据来自小规模且方法学异质的队列，外周pTDP-43病理并非仅限于ALS，强调了进行更大规模标准化研究的必要性。
